description: The file defines a class `ScreenRecordService` responsible for recording the screen using ReplayKit, handling video and audio inputs, managing capture sessions, and writing output files. It includes error handling, configuration setup, and integration with AVFoundation for media processing.

classes.name: ScreenRecordService
classes.description: A class managing screen recording sessions, handling sample buffers, configuring AVAssetWriter, and managing capture lifecycle.

classes.name: UncheckedSendableBox
classes.description: A wrapper struct to allow sending non-Sendable types across concurrency boundaries.

classes.name: CaptureState
classes.description: A class encapsulating the current state of a capture session, including writer, inputs, and error info.

classes.name: ScreenRecordError
classes.description: An enumeration of possible errors during screen recording, with localized descriptions.

methods.name: record
methods.description: Main method to start a screen recording for a specified duration, returning the output file path.

methods.name: makeRecordConfig
methods.description: Creates configuration parameters for recording such as file URL, duration, and FPS.

methods.name: makeOutputURL
methods.description: Generates a URL for the output file, either from a supplied path or temporary directory.

methods.name: startCapture
methods.description: Begins the ReplayKit screen capture session asynchronously.

methods.name: makeCaptureHandler
methods.description: Creates a handler closure for processing sample buffers during capture.

methods.name: handleVideoSample
methods.description: Processes incoming video sample buffers, writes frames, and manages the AVAssetWriterInput.

methods.name: prepareWriter
methods.description: Initializes AVAssetWriter and its inputs for capturing video and optionally audio.

methods.name: handleAudioSample
methods.description: Processes incoming audio sample buffers if audio recording is enabled.

methods.name: finalizeCapture
methods.description: Completes the capture session, finalizes the writer, and checks for errors.

methods.name: finishWriting
methods.description: Finalizes writing the captured media to disk asynchronously.
